chunks.text: Today we will talk about weddings.

Have you ever been to a wedding?
Maybe you have been to a big wedding with hundreds of guests or a small wedding with close family members.
No matter what kind of wedding you attend, knowing some English phrases will help you feel more comfortable.

First let's learn some important words about weddings.
